findings.claim: T11 is ticked [x] but its task text still lists only the original S9 mapping and does not reflect the accepted S9 amendment recorded in L65 (read→Read, skill→Skill mapped). L65 says S9 was amended by review, yet the diff does not update the S9 spec text or the T11 line. A reader of the Specs or T11 sees a stale S9 mapping, which contradicts the delivered behavior and the L10 map the T9 line cites.

L65 is a single very long paragraph that mixes delivery record, verifier outcome, corrections, spec change, answers and an open routed item. The open item (other PreToolUse guards have no OpenCode bridge; T16 to declare them unsupported) is buried at the end and is not tied to any task line or checkbox, so it is easy to lose. Also uses a stray apostrophe-like backtick in words such as engine`s and bridge`s, which breaks inline code rendering.

evidence: The diff changes only odd/tasks/labdrian-orchestrator-opencode.md: ticks T11, adds five commit hashes, appends log entry L65.
L65 states S9 was amended (read/skill mapping) and plugin passes path as file_path, but no Specs section edit appears in the diff.
L65 contains several backticks used as apostrophes (engine`s, Claude Code`s, bridge`s), producing unbalanced inline code spans.
